name: OpenCove
where_agents_run: your machine, or remote machines over SSH (managed Workers); browser Web UI (experimental)
source_note: Checked against its README, CHANGELOG (to v0.3.3 and Unreleased), docs/ (agent runtime, CLI, control surface, releasing, UI), agent settings source, and the v0.3.3 release assets. Not installed or run here; used as a visual-design reference for Pantheon.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Kimi on one canvas

harness_count.value: 5 to launch; Gemini kept for old sessions only

needs_you_signal.value: Waiting status, standby banners, system notifications

approve_deny_prompt.value: Answer in the agent's terminal; no allow button

cross_provider_delegation.value: Agents can open other agents via its CLI; no hand-off view

conversation_gui_view.value: Agents shown as terminals; no chat view in docs

real_terminal.value: Full terminals (xterm.js + node-pty) on the canvas

session_organization.value: Infinite canvas, projects, nested Spaces, sidebar groups

prompt_scratchpad.value: Notes on the canvas; phrase insertion into terminals

saved_prompt_library.value: Task prompt templates, reusable roles, quick phrases

builtin_editors_browser.value: Monaco file editor, file explorer, full browser windows

appearance_control.value: 5 themes; UI and terminal font size and family

vault_task_source.value: Tasks and notes live on its own canvas

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: No issue intake in docs; shows a PR chip per worktree

worktree_management.value: Space per git worktree, create and archive

planner_orchestrator.value: Tasks run by agents you pick; no auto-split in docs

knowledge_base.value: Canvas notes agents can read through its CLI

phone_no_new_app.value: Experimental Web UI in a browser on your network

remote_ssh.value: Managed SSH Workers run sessions on other machines

os.value: Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon, Intel), Linux; browser Web UI (experimental)

background_process.value: Yes: a local Worker process owns terminals and sessions

download_size.value: v0.3.3: 128 MB Windows, 150-156 MB macOS, 163 MB AppImage, 124 MB deb

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app plus a Worker process)

runs_in_terminal.value: Own desktop app window; CLI is for scripting

extensibility.value: CLI and local HTTP API; no plugin system in docs

stability_maturity.value: Alpha; v0.3.3 (2026-09-12) plus nightlies; since Feb 2026
